description: ECAI's class ecai.cls ('2023/12/10 v04 ECAI document class', file of 2024-01-03, cleaned up by Ulle Endriss after VTeX's 2023 adaptation to IOS Press's book markup), from ecai-template.zip on ecai2025.org (wp-content/uploads/2025/04/ecai-template.zip, linked from the ECAI 2025 call for papers; its README: 'Latest revision: 2025-04-01'). This is the latest ECAI kit of its own: ECAI 2026 is held jointly with IJCAI (IJCAI-ECAI 2026), whose papers use the IJCAI kit (setting ijcai). Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror. A class of its own, not built on article: A4, twoside, two columns and final by default (l.115). No options: doubleblind hides the authors for review. It loads comment, lineno [switch], times, [T1]{fontenc}, etoolbox, forloop, url, environ and natbib [numbers] with \bibliographystyle{abbrvnat} (l.1325-1327, the mirror's natbib). The template sets the title, authors and addresses inside the frontmatter environment (l.776-810), which calls \maketitle; \maketitle also works alone, and \author takes an optional address key (\author[A]{...}), so a plain \author{...} works. No preamble. The kit's eurai.pdf is only a figure in the sample and is not shipped. Under XeTeX times' ptm has no TU shape; General's fontspec lines give Latin Modern. The README lists hyperref, subfig and subcaption as not compatible with the class, and General loads hyperref in every document. Licence: none (the header: 'I claim no copyright'); kept private with the other kits. ecai.cls makes page 1 42pt shorter (\ftextheight) and every later page \ntextheight (671pt) tall, set from page 1's foot (l.1333-1351); the preamble line reports that height to the oracle after the last page, since the host's geometry line is written at \begin{document}, while page 1's height is in force.
